authorInfo.bio: Mary Gardiner Horsford (1824–1855) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Indian Legends and Other Poems" by Mary Gardiner Horsford is a collection of poems written in the mid-19th century, exploring themes rooted in American Indigenous culture and history. The book presents an array of poetic narratives that delve into legends and folklore, aiming to capture the essence of the lives, beliefs, and struggles of Native American tribes.
